title: Revealing urban vegetation dynamics: Comprehensive NDVI time series analysis and forecasting using ARIMA/SARIMA models in Karachi

idea.research_question: Can monthly NDVI derived from Landsat 8 surface reflectance characterise urban vegetation dynamics in Karachi and support accurate seasonal forecasting?
idea.hypothesis: A monthly Landsat 8 NDVI series contains a stable seasonal signal that can be represented by a SARIMA model and used to forecast near-term urban vegetation conditions.
idea.mechanism: Mask and scale Landsat 8 Level 2 surface reflectance, calculate NDVI from the red and near-infrared bands, aggregate valid observations monthly, and model the resulting series with ARIMA/SARIMA.
idea.analytical_approach: Single-source Landsat 8 NDVI time-series analysis with trend, seasonality, residual diagnostics and ARIMA/SARIMA forecast evaluation
idea.expected_contribution: A reproducible single-dataset benchmark for deriving Landsat 8 NDVI and evaluating seasonal urban-vegetation forecasts.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject the hypothesis if a holdout evaluation shows that the fitted seasonal model does not improve on an appropriate non-seasonal or persistence baseline.

seed_audit.migration_note: Migrated from dual_dataset/task_010 on 2026-10-07 because the paper derives NDVI from Landsat 8 rather than operationally combining two independent source datasets.
